Package logic.game

Class GameSession

java.lang.Object
logic.game.GameSession
public class GameSession extends Object
Manages the overall game session state across multiple levels. Keeps track of the current level, the player instance, and all rewards collected so far. A session is considered complete once all five levels have been finished.
